name: Bio-LNG and liquefied biomethane
principle: Biogas is upgraded to biomethane, then liquefied with a small-scale liquefier to give a drop-in LNG substitute for heavy transport and shipping. Shell commissioned a bio-LNG plant of about 100,000 tonnes a year in April 2024 (location not confirmed by the page read).

performance.basis: Natural Gas World, April 2024; site and feedstock not stated in the text read

source.note: Natural Gas World, Shell inaugurates Germany's largest bio-LNG production plant, 19 April 2024

advantages: Counts as renewable fuel under many schemes (not checked)
